logo.note: Icons.logo in the shadcn/ui site's own icons.tsx, copied into a standalone SVG: the viewBox, the rect and both lines verbatim, with the JSX attribute names written the SVG way (strokeWidth as stroke-width). It draws in currentColor, black where no colour is set. shadcn publishes no logo guidelines; the repository is MIT.

provenance.notes: The :root and .dark variable blocks, vendored verbatim as scripts/sources/shadcn/{light,dark}.json.
The palette, type scale, spacing base, radii, shadows and easings, vendored as scripts/sources/shadcn/tailwind.json.
